raw_prompt: !fix compilation error for the knockback bow. refer to documentation for the on projectile hit
reviewer_feedback: Fixed the projectile hit event logic to correctly target the victim and added a check to ensure only arrows fired from the Skyward Bow trigger the effect.
usage_instructions: Use /give-skyward-bow to obtain the special knockback bow.
Shoot any living entity to launch them into the air.

traces.intent_summary: Fix compilation errors in the knockback bow script by correctly implementing the projectile hit event.

traces.rationale: The original script used 'event-entity' in a projectile hit context, which can be ambiguous or refer to the projectile itself depending on the Skript version. Using 'victim' is the standard, reliable way to reference the entity hit by a projectile. I also added a check to ensure the projectile is an arrow to prevent errors from other projectiles like snowballs or tridents.
